description: DE-WWTP - collection of Germany's waste water treatment plants (status 2015) is a data set listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by Büttner, Olaf (deposited on HydroShare). The waste water treatment data collection for Germany (DE-WWTP) was collected and put together at the UFZ in 2015/2016. Coverage: Germany. The resource was created 2020-02-18 and last updated 2020-03-13; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
